sections.Profile:
The "Cinderella" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, featuring artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
